milestones.work: David, F., Kupiainen, A., Rhodes, R., Vargas, V., Liouville quantum gravity on the Riemann sphere, Comm. Math. Phys., 2016
milestones.description: The 2016 paper constructs the Liouville path integral probabilistically on the sphere, the first purposeful use of the chaos tools on the physics object.

evidence.claim: Article in Comm. Math. Phys., 2016 (DOI 10.1007/s00220-016-2572-4)
A rigorous probabilistic construction of the path integral was found in the 2010s

milestones.note: 'First' is judged from the Wikipedia dating in the 2010s; no other earlier probabilistic construction was checked.

milestones.work: Kupiainen, A., Rhodes, R., Vargas, V., The DOZZ formula from the path integral, JHEP, 2018
milestones.description: This paper derives the DOZZ structure constants from the probabilistic path integral.

evidence.claim: Article in JHEP, 2018 (DOI 10.1007/jhep05(2018)094)

milestones.label: Integrability of Liouville theory: proof of the DOZZ formula

milestones.description: The Annals paper proves the DOZZ formula and the conformal bootstrap for Liouville theory, the main theorem of the event.
